provenance: Original sentences for this repository. No third-party corpus is copied. Each row's provenance field is one of: pattern (written from the rule shapes), review (benign rows taken from the topics in the #50 review), blind (attacks written without reading the detector rules), unit_test (the two rows that repeat a unit-test sentence), issue_12 (the spaced-letter probes), or probe (the concatenated-token fixture).
